objectives.text: Accept page, size and sort query parameters as a Pageable and pass it to a repository method
Predict the content and page metadata of a response for a given page, size and sort
Return a stable paged JSON shape with PagedModel instead of serializing PageImpl directly

minutes.basis: Measured for the minimum release on the authored artifact.html with the frozen authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py (sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f): modeledP50 8.51 (962 words, 13 code lines, interactions {"predict":1,"terminal_step":2,"explore":1,"mcq":1,"confidence":1}). modeledWorstPath 11.01 = P50 plus the intake worst-route allowance of 2.5 minutes (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit; course-1 measured worst-path gaps were 2.41-2.65 minutes above P50, see authoring/evidence/spring-boot/intake.md, Minute budgets). This worst path was modeled, not measured on these pages. budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(P50, worst path)) under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, within the 15 minute cap.
